procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/attala/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as Adams: p1 is the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A (11 precincts, then 9 precincts + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the next section (Circuit 5 Place 2) plus the local sections. The section boundary between tables falls CLEANLY between Circuit 5 Place 1's row block (table A, complete with its header, ends p2/p3's stream at Joseph H. 'Joey' Loper Jr.) and Place 2's own section (table B opens with the 'Circuit Court 5-Circuit District 05 Place 2' header) -- no continuation row this time. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald, sole candidate; her section prints X position marks in the precincts outside the Court of Appeals 2 sub-district on this sheet -- six of the eleven p2 columns and six of the nine p3 columns); Chancery Court 6-Chancery District 06 Place 1 (Doug S. Crosby) and Place 2 (Kiley Catledge Kirk); Circuit Court 5-Circuit District 05 Place 1 (Joseph H. 'Joey' Loper Jr.) and Place 2 (Alan D. 'Devo' Lancaster). Printed totals: Colom 2920, Hyde-Smith 3045, Pinkins 96, Eller 3040, G. Thompson 2896, Foster 113, McDonald 1932, Crosby 5095, Kirk 4846, Loper 4976, Lancaster 4789.
operator_rows_note: All 11 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry cells on both supply pages (p2: eleven precinct cells; p3: nine precinct cells + printed TOTAL). McDonald's row supplies only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL (1182+750 = 1932), the established X-cell rule.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty precinct headers print complete (bare names -- Berea, Carmack, East, Ethel, Hesterville, Liberty Chapel, Mcadams, Mccool, Newport, North Central, North East, North West, Possumneck, Providence, Sallis, South Central, South West, Thompson, Williamsville, Zama).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 5 Place 2: School Board District-Attala County School Board District 5 (Shelia Rone) and Kosciusko School Board Trustee-Kosciusko School Board Trustee (Shirley Cross Henderson, Dr. Kenneth Quick) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. The sheet's row stream ends there; no further local sections (Constable, Election Commission, Coroner) print on pages 1-5.
